column1: # output_fix_map.tsv — OUTPUT-SIDE ONLY. Never used by build_vNN.py.
# These are forms the MODEL INVENTS. They do not appear in the training corpus,
# so they cannot be fixed by a build-side map and must not be added to
# calque_map.tsv — doing so would make the corpus compliance check report
# violations for forms that were never there.
# Established by the v13 sweep: a rule was in calque_map.tsv, corpus compliance
# was 100.0% (zero occurrences), and every checkpoint still emitted the wrong
# form anyway. See v13_provenance.md §3.
# 2026-08-17 — the Cold War rules were REMOVED from this file. All three forms
# (سوغۇق ئۇرۇش، سوغۇق مۇناسىۋەتلەر ئۇرۇشى، سوغۇقچىلىق ئۇرۇشى) turned out to be
# attested in published Uyghur; that is register variation among valid synonyms,
# not a calque, and a normalizer has no business picking between them. Variant
# preference belongs in the eval synonym map, not here.
# NOT loaded by default. Pass it explicitly:
#     python uyghur_normalize.py --in out.txt --fix-map normalizer/output_fix_map.tsv
# Format: variant<TAB>standard[<TAB>flags]. Longest LHS wins. Suffix-aware.
# Applied AFTER calque/era/imla_loan, so right-hand sides must already be in
# correct 2009/2011 imla — nothing runs after this pass to clean them.
# FLAGS
#   nosfx   fire only on the bare form. Use when the replacement is ALREADY
#           inflected, so appending a captured suffix would double it.
# EVIDENCE COLUMN: only add a rule here after seeing the form in actual model
# output. Do not add speculatively.
# ---- fault line ----
# v13 ep8 -9.3 chrF. Model produces two competing literal calques.
پارچىلىنىش لىنىيەسى
پارچىلىنىش سىزىقى
يېرىق سىزىقى
# ---- nation state ----
# v13 ep8 -13.1 chrF, the single largest regression. Number-agreement error:
# the model collapses the plural to a singular possessive compound.
# NOTE: singular «مىللىي دۆلەت» is correct where the English IS singular.
# This rule assumes the plural, which is the attested failure. If you see it
# fire on a genuine singular, narrow it or remove it.
# nosfx: the replacement is already plural; a captured suffix would stack on it.
مىللەت دۆلىتى
